parts.text: Which claim correctly links rocks, minerals, metals, and careful use?

options.text: Rocks are made of minerals; metals come from minerals; slow formation means rocks and minerals should be used responsibly.
Minerals are made of rocks, and metals form first so that rocks can appear later.
Building stone must be conserved, but minerals used to make cars need no careful use.
Wherever many rocks are visible, they may be used without limits.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Navya reads that rocks are made of minerals, that metals such as iron and copper are extracted from minerals, and that rocks form over thousands to millions of years.

part_answers.answer: Rocks are made of minerals that yield metals, and slow formation means heavy use without care depletes resources that take a very long time to replace.

teacher.key_rationale: Rocks are made of minerals; metals are extracted from minerals; slow formation requires responsible use. Reversing rocks and minerals, exempting industrial minerals, or using visibility as a free pass miss that hinge.
